verification.decision: accepted_bounded_PNG_shared_pixels_AS2_attachment_disposal_and_Restart

reviewedEntries.scopeNote: Three Bitmap views are created from live buffers; two display the same shared16×16 buffer and one displays an independent clone. Integer transforms and nearest-neighbor rendering work in this scene. Empty/default/null construction, subclassing and all constructor coercions are unverified.

The authored PNG exposes its BitmapData; left/right view reads compare equal to shared while the clone view differs. Pixel mutation changes both shared views without changing the PNG or independent clone. Setter reassignment/null disposal behavior is not established.

Cloning an authored16×16 PNG preserves its sampled pixels; the second clone owns independent pixels after scroll/copy and remains unchanged by shared-view paint. Full allocation/coercion and every alpha case are unverified.

Integer rectangle fill creates the gold4×4 patch and paints the shared8×6 center orange then purple, visibly updating both views. Original and independent clone retain their contents. Clipped/negative/fractional and partial-alpha fills are outside this pass.
Setting(15,15) to0xfff08080 creates the visible salmon pixel in shared views. Other alpha values, transparent-to-opaque conversion and out-of-bounds behavior are unverified.

The independent clone scrolls2 pixels right, leaves its exposed gold edge unchanged at(0,0), and displays the shifted image before a separate copy operation. Other directions, extreme shifts and full transparent-edge behavior are unverified.

Copying PNG rectangle(4,3,8,8) to clone point(0,8) gives expected0xff2ad4a5 at(0,8) and(7,15), with a distinct visible clone. Masks, mergeAlpha, overlapping copy and clipping are not browser-accepted.
Painting sets RGB(0,0)=0x1f3045 while preserving the existing opaque alpha: getPixel32 returns0xff1f3045. Fractional coordinates, nonopaque alpha and invalid color conversion remain unverified.

Selected transparent/opaque PNG and clone samples match independently decoded bytes, and paint reports0xffff965c then0xff8b9dff. A disposed clone read gives the explicit diagnostic. Exhaustive pixel/alpha and original Flash rounding equivalence are not claimed.
After setPixel, reading(0,0) returns RGB0x1f3045 without alpha, beside getPixel32=0xff1f3045. Transparent/out-of-range reads and full coordinate conversion are unverified.
The shared16-pixel buffer width appears in the actual status and ready trace. Other dimensions, setters and allocation boundaries are not accepted by this getter observation.
The shared16-pixel buffer height appears in the actual status and ready trace. Other dimensions, setters and allocation boundaries are not accepted by this getter observation.
The decoded PNG buffer reports transparent=true while a selected empty pixel reads0. The opaque BitmapData mode and read-only enforcement are not tested.
The original PNG rect.width reads16 through its returned geometry object. Full rect coordinates, clone independence and mutation/writeback semantics are not tested.

Disposing the independent displayed clone removes its pixels and makes a subsequent getPixel32 read fail explicitly. Both shared views still paint, and Restart recreates the clone. Idempotence, shared-buffer disposal and all stale-reference operations are unverified.

Append-depth attachBitmap renders the new AS2 pixel buffer under its own MovieClip at scale600%. It shows the green base, orange rectangle and changed top-left pixel. Arbitrary depth replacement, return value, smoothing/snapping behavior and pointer dispatch are unverified.
A valid new BitmapData(16,16,true,0xff2ad4a5) creates the visible AS2 buffer; getters report16/16/true. Defaults, coercions, limits and historical invalid-constructor behavior are unverified.
Filling rectangle(4,4,8,8) with0xffff965c produces the visible orange center in the AS2 attached image. Clipping, alpha and alternate rectangle forms are not accepted.
Setting(0,0) to0xff122233 changes the AS2 buffer; its readback equals4279378483 and the image is rendered. Other alpha/coercion/out-of-bounds behavior is unverified.
The actual AS2 trace reads(0,0)=0xff122233 after its write, beside the visible attached image. Other pixel cases and historical disposed sentinels are unverified.
The AS2 rectangle alias returns width16 and is used in visible status and trace. Other fields, mutation, identity and rect alias equivalence are not exhaustively tested.
The created AS2 buffer reports width16 in its trace. Other sizes and writes are unverified.
The created AS2 buffer reports height16 in its trace. Other sizes and writes are unverified.
The AS2 constructor true argument is read back as true on the rendered buffer. Opaque mode and property writes are unverified.

Only invalid new BitmapData(0,1) was called directly in AS3 and produced the caught positive-dimensions RangeError. Valid AS3 new construction remains independently untested; existing positive buffers came from PNG decoding and clone. Do not count this as a working constructor.

supersededRules.title: Authored handler lifecycle
supersededRules.reason: New placements queue authored Load handlers; frame entry queues frame scripts; ticks queue authored EnterFrame handlers; clicks bubble authored handlers from leaf through ancestor placements. Dispatch skips stale lifetime/source/frame entries and enforces a 4096 event budget.
supersededRules.limitations: Only four serialized event kinds (load, click, enter_frame, frame). Order is explicitly NeoFlash initial semantics, not Flash verified. Assigning AS2 onEnterFrame is silently custom state and is never invoked (separate finding). No dynamically registered listeners, capture/priority/default prevention or stop propagation. AS3 event bindings are not automatically available in lowered scripts.

supersededRules.title: Instance navigation and frame queries
supersededRules.reason: root/_root and parent/_parent return proxies; currentFrame and totalFrames return shared model data. Unmapped reads search custom state, then direct child by authored name. Proxy identity is scoped to JSON instance-ID path plus placement lifetime.
supersededRules.limitations: No getChildByName/getChildAt/addChild/removeChild/DisplayObjectContainer implementation. The root is the authored root scene; AS3 Stage/root loader semantics are absent. Legacy slash paths, _levelN, target-path string resolution and dynamic display tree are not provided.

supersededRules.title: Numeric display properties
supersededRules.reason: Six numeric properties map to Rust transform overrides. AS2 alpha/scale use percentages; AS3 uses scalar alpha/scale. AS2 setters Number-coerce before finite validation.
supersededRules.limitations: Root transform setter is rejected; only active non-root placements receive overrides. AS3 setters require finite JS numbers; alpha must be in [0,1]. This is bounded host validation, not proof of Flash coercion semantics. rotation 370 reads back 370; Adobe AS3 documents normalization to 10.

supersededRules.title: Timeline controls
supersededRules.reason: Six timeline methods are exposed on every instance proxy. Frames are one-based and string labels resolve before numeric strings; an independent MovieClip or root timeline can be controlled.
supersededRules.limitations: No AS3 scene parameter or scene model. Graphic/synchronized symbols do not have independent clocks. nextFrame/prevFrame clamp and stop. play/stop return a Boolean from WASM instead of documented void; observed play() => true. General Flash frame entry/reentrancy ordering is not established by differential tests.

supersededRules.title: Shared button display proxy
supersededRules.reason: Serialized Button symbol placements use the same transform/parent proxy. Seven AS2 properties are inferred from this shared route; no individual Button execution or Flash up/over/down/hit state support is claimed.
supersededRules.limitations: Use only within the exact reviewed rule; no full Flash compatibility is claimed.

Native audio/Library integration and Sources/D-008 remain pending; the unsaved native document was untouched. The earlier direct-file URL-policy refusal was not retried. Embedded Play receives native metadata and Start, supports pause/seek/resume to Stop, and repeats once after Restart. A later same-origin /video-fixture.mp4 GET receives HTTP 200; metadata count 2, native Start and time 0.032 appear with changed pixels before Restart interrupts it. HTTP completion and large-file progressive buffering are not observed.

pause(true) actively pauses at observed time 0.206717 with Pause.Notify and unchanged paused screenshot; pause(false) resumes the paused two-second position, receives Unpause.Notify and reaches Stop at 4. No no-argument toggle or arbitrary Boolean coercion is accepted.

The authored seek(2) moves the paused stream to time 2, receives Seek.Notify and visibly changes its frame before resume. The AS3 negative-seek evidence is not inherited by this AS2 row; no general seek precision claim.

Close occurs after native Stop at 4, resets time to 0 and retains the entire authored Video crop. The repeated close performed beside AS3 clear leaves its image and completed count unchanged. Active-playback close interruption is not tested.
The guarded local Connect.Success callback initializes the legacy stream at startup and Restart. No remote or general failure-status route is accepted.

Native embedded metadata 1, HTTP metadata 2, then fresh embedded metadata 1 each report 320x180/duration 4 and this===legacyStream. Callback precedes Start per load. No HTTP completion, cue points or general media metadata behavior.
The getter reports false after successful local connect(null), both initially and after Restart. This is the local-file connection contract, not a server connectivity check.

Recorded native seconds include active pause 0.248697, seek 2, resumed 2.004976, ended 4 and close 0; fresh playback ends at 4. These are observed values and transitions, not clock precision or full original-player timing equivalence.

Recorded native seconds include active pause 0.206717, seek 2, resumed 2.00851, ended 4, close 0 and HTTP 0.032 before Restart. Fresh playback ends at 4. No exact synchronization or clock precision claim.

Getter reports 0 before metadata and 320 after actual native MP4 decode in initial and fresh sessions. This is source-media width for the tested 320x180 asset, not general viewport or malformed-codec handling.
Getter reports 0 before metadata and 180 after actual native MP4 decode in initial and fresh sessions. This is source-media height for the tested 320x180 asset, not every codec or dimension boundary.
Getter reports 8709 after embedded resource metadata, exactly matching the independent source asset length, in both sessions. No native HTTP buffer/download counter acceptance.

rules.title: AS2 hour: platform
rules.reason: Bounded AS2-only delivery with ordinary HTML5 execution. New implementations, expanded existing behavior and stale catalogue corrections are counted separately in docs/AS2-RUNTIME-HOUR.md.
rules.limitations: Browser-backed NeoFlash System capability profile, IME composition listener registration, observed keyboard modifiers, Delegate and plain-object EventDispatcher via owned Rust broadcaster, getVersion/updateAfterEvent and AS2-owned stopAllSounds. No OS IME control, Flash identity, policy bypass, UI components, audible-playback or native IME input acceptance. HTML5 8/8, real key A and Restart; source-family review, not individual conformance.

verification.decision: Reviewed exact AS2 declarations against owned source and representative ordinary HTML5 family results. No per-entry Flash conformance claim.

rules.title: AS2 two-hour batch: data
rules.reason: Bounded AS2-only delivery against baseline b3edf75 with exact normalized inventory: 320 reviewed declarations, 278 new, 12 extended and 30 reviewed-existing. New implementations are counted separately from stale catalogue promotions. The AS3 audit is unchanged. Representative family HTML5 observations do not establish individual API or original Flash conformance.
rules.limitations: Nonvisual reference-preserving collections/providers, Rust record views/CRUD/sort/filter/ranges/cursors, snapshot iterators, local coalesced delta packets and explicit-event primitive one/two-way binding. No UI component inheritance, remote resolver acknowledgement, XML/XPath/schema engine, custom formatters or tracked direct row mutation. Coordinator ordinary HTML5: 14/14. The catalogue constant rows EndPoint.constant and DeltaItem.kind are instance fields, not new static constants. Family observations plus source review; class/interface availability does not claim every member.

verification.browser: Codex in-app browser; native browser file chooser for FileReference acceptance
verification.decision: Coordinator accepted the ordinary authored HTML5 family results described in limitations. Captured final working-tree source bytes and per-entry bounded scope were reviewed; no independent individual-API conformance run. Native file saving and audible sound output were not assessed.

rules.title: Calibrate AS2 simulated/bounded Player APIs from working to partial (A-01)
rules.reason: Demotes AS2 live RTMP streaming, hardware Camera/Microphone capture, XMLSocket, LocalConnection, remote SharedObject, PrintJob, FileReference, IME and external _levelN SWF loading from working to partial with explicit limitation notes.
rules.limitations: Partial entries name their missing behavior; working entries are covered by the listed tests. Not an original Flash differential result.
